description: Official Tripo3D asset manifest for Forge Frenzy. See docs/15_TRIPO_ASSET_MANIFEST.md for conventions. Generating assets with paid Tripo credits requires owner authorization.
styleSentence: Stylized fantasy-industrial blacksmithing asset for a Roblox simulator with a chunky readable silhouette, slightly exaggerated proportions, clean low-to-mid poly forms, bold hand-painted materials and subtle magical glow, no photorealism and no gritty PBR detail.

priorities.critical: Needed for the playable loop or the first impression; generate first.
priorities.important: Needed for the complete game; a coherent fallback exists until generated.
priorities.nice-to-have: Polish or premium extras; skip freely if budget is tight.

categories.name: Standard weapon base meshes (Common to Epic)
Signature set pieces and hero props
